channel.title: Olive Oil Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Olive Oil Times (oliveoiltimes.com)

item.title: Italy’s Organic Food Market Nears €7 Billion as Demand Outpaces Supply
item.description: A new report says organic is expanding in Italy, but organic extra virgin olive oil remains a niche.

item.title: EU-India Trade Pact Could Lower Barriers for Greek Olive Oil Exports
item.description: A new EU-India free trade agreement could phase out India’s steep olive oil import duties over five years, potentially narrowing the price gap for consumers.

item.title: Mandranova Blends Hospitality and Olive Oil Craft in Southern Sicily
item.description: The family-run estate near Palma di Montechiaro pairs olive groves and almond orchards with 15 guest rooms and a private villa, offering visitors a closer look at how award-winning extra virgin olive oil is made.

item.title: How Extra Virgin Olive Oil Can Become America’s Default Kitchen Fat
item.description: Updated U.S. dietary guidance has put extra virgin olive oil in the spotlight, but experts say the biggest health gains come when it replaces other fats as the default choice for everyday cooking.

item.title: Morocco Expands Protection for Regional Olive Oils
item.description: Morocco’s Agriculture Ministry has launched a new certification drive to expand geographical indications and protected origin labels, with olive oil a top priority.

item.title: Food Safety Authority Seeks Public Input as EU Reassesses Xylella Fastidiosa Control Options
item.description: A sweeping assessment of studies across the EU concludes there is no field-ready cure for Xylella fastidiosa, as regulators consider updates to surveillance and containment.

item.title: At 80, Croatian Producer Drago Malić Wins Gold at 2026 NYIOOC
item.description: A retired math and physics teacher with four decades in olive growing, Drago Malić won Croatia a Gold Award at the 2026 NYIOOC with a blend led by Oblica.

item.title: As Pakistan Olive Industry Matures, Producers See China as The Next Growth Engine
item.description: Pakistan’s fast-growing olive sector is seeking deeper collaboration with China on processing technology, certification and market access as production and quality programs expand.

item.title: Historic Award for Iranian Olive Oil Producer Comes as Conflict Shuts Down Business
item.description: Saeed Shahmoradi became the first Iranian producer to win at the NYIOOC, but celebrations were quickly overtaken by conflict, business closures and deepening economic uncertainty in Tehran.

item.title: Scientists Say Andalusia’s Recent Weather Extremes Point to Wider Mediterranean Trend
item.description: After floods, strong winds and frosts damaged groves in parts of Andalusia, scientists said the disruption reflects a broader Mediterranean climate shift marked by rising aridity and more volatile weather.
